title: Tôi cần nạp thêm dữ liệu
pronunciation: toy gun nap them yoo lee-ew

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi cần nạp thêm dữ liệu is the short line for naming what you need next. It works best when data top-up is visible on your phone, ticket, note, shelf, or in the situation around you.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi cần nạp thêm dữ liệu with the object, screen, or note visible. Beginners should keep the main travel detail visible and say the short sentence once.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Use these nearby pages when the conversation shifts from I need a data top-up to another phone, internet, or power need.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use this in a real phone, internet, or power exchange when data top-up is the detail you need resolved. The likely reply is a point, option, yes/no answer, or next step, so keep the phrase short and ready for one follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Phone and Wi-Fi answers can be technical. Let the screen stay visible so the other person can point, type, or check the setting.

sections.title: Explore next
